who: claude-fable-5-2 (Claude Fable 5.2), lane outside-looks, int-1112; ported to the end state by claude-opus-5-5 (Claude Opus 5.5), track 2 of round /tmp/plan/MASTER.md
where: crates/blaze-vfs/src/outside.rs looked, looked_file, take_file_looks; crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/job/certify.rs Building::end; crates/blaze-cargo/src/serve/job.rs keep_answer
what: A build's looks at the disk outside the views are collected in process-wide statics (LOOKS, NAMED_LOOKS, FILE_LOOKS, LAST_LOOK) capped at 64 distinct paths. take_file_looks says None past the cap, for any entry or listing look, and for a file look that returned an error before looked_file; Building::end then refuses the certificate and names last_look(), a path that need not be the cause (smoke row 2 named glibc's crtn.o, a file look with an answer). Two consumers (the certificate's Building and the old no-op Recording) drain and switch the same statics at one Finish.
cost: smoke row 2 (a no-op of 115 units, 3.6 s) is never answered by a certificate; the lane spent half its context finding that the message cannot say which look refused it
cause: not measured: by reading, most likely the 64-path cap on a first build after a daemon start, when no answer is vouched yet and every outside read is a look
class: a build's reads collected through a process-global side channel with a cap, instead of returned with the read to the build that made it
prevention: a look is a typed value (path, kind, digest, caller) pushed to a handle its build owns; no handle, no look; no static list
fix: built, not yet compiled: blaze_vfs::outside keeps no look in any static; a Look (path, kind File/Entry/Listing, answer, caller) is pushed to the Looks its build owns (made in Jobs::certify_building, set on Job::looks, handed to each task as JobInput::looks; Looks::none() where no build is looked for). Every site takes the handle: blaze-usercode Files::file/entry, Now::names, RootMap::with/resolve/to_map, script::prepare; base-db read_now/content_now/reload_included_*; blaze-lints profile::load; blaze-lower Lowered::refresh; the daemon's native layout (each job pushes the layout's Entry as it takes the shared answer; laid_out pushes nothing). Building::end refuses only a path seen at two values, naming both callers (looked_twice); certify_write values each look as Read::Outside/Read::Entry/Read::Listing at its own digest (certify::looked_reads), and a check asks each again (outside_now). The old no-op Recording takes Walk::looks from the build's Looks; Unkept::Looked names the path, Unkept::Unlooked a build that kept no list.
state: fixed in the int-1112 tree, awaiting the main agent's compile and test run
control: request/tests.rs: a_build_that_looked_at_the_disk_is_certified_and_answered_again (65 files + 1 entry + 1 listing on a temp dir, written then hit); a_moved_{file,entry,listing}_the_build_looked_at_is_a_miss, each with the_oracle_catches_the_{file,entry,listing}s_left_out_of_the_record under Plant::DropsLooked(kind), which wrongly hits and the oracle refuses; a_path_seen_at_two_values_names_both_callers. blaze-vfs outside/tests.rs: two builds' Looks share nothing. noop/tests.rs: a_walk_that_looked_at_files_is_answered_while_they_are_the_same (now also a file seen twice keeps none).
